page.overview:
Who is Jen?

Sister Jen was a fierce, unpredictable acolyte in training at the Sisterhood School who rarely revealed her emotional core.

Jen was training to be a Truthsayer with the Sisterhood under Valya and Tula Harkonnen. As part of their training, they examined a brain and had to decide what the person was. While Theodosia and Emeline were sure he was a criminal or a sociopath, Jen correctly said he was a survivor. Tula used that to transition to a lesson in the bodily signs they were learning to detect.

During a later lesson, in which they had to determine if the prisoner facing them was telling the truth or lying, Valya challenged Jen, asking why she was there if she thought it was so easy to deceive people. Jen said that her parents sold her to a man who made his money peddling the flesh of children and he killed him and then her parents. Then she admitted she was making it up.

One night, Lila asked Jen why she was there. She knew the story Jen told wasn't truth, but there was some truth behind it. Lila herself had been raised in the Sisterhood and didn't know who her parents were. Jen told her not to worry as the past would find her.
